Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func OrderChanges(changes [][3]string) ([]string, bool)
Behavior: Each change is id,parentId,sequence; '-' means no parent. IDs match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)* and sequence is an integer in 0..10,000,000. Reject duplicates, unknown/self/cyclic parents. Return dependency-safe order, choosing smallest sequence then Unicode code-point id among ready changes.
Visible example: a,-,2; b,a,0; c,-,1 returns [c,a,b].

Buggy source to repair:

package solution
func OrderChanges([][3]string)([]string,bool){return nil,false}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
